title: Member API contributions: the owner's account, connection metadata and selected-project grants, admin narrowing, a member's explicit funding pin and task funding, behind actor-scoped idempotency
why: SOPHIA-INC-2026-11 INC-01 slice S5 (INC01-CC-004 S5b): the HTTP boundary for migration 0094's records and functions. Its generated output is regenerated with `pnpm --filter @sophia/contracts generate`, never by hand.
No existing operation covers it. /projects/{projectId}/contributions is the discussion contribution (A05) and is not overloaded: these are `api-contributions`.

The actor is the verified token subject. No field names an owner, requester, payer, credential, runtime or capability; unknown fields are refused. Authority (owner, the grant's project admin, a current editor) is decided by the database under its locks. Every write takes an Idempotency-Key: the same key and request replays the first receipt under the caller's current authority; another request under it conflicts.

Metadata and control only: no key intake, registration, qualification or execution endpoint. A connection state of connected is not live authentication, qualification or funding. Served only when the API is built with apiContributions (off by default).

value.description: One reason a contribution cannot fund new work now. An empty list means ready for that actor; a connection state of connected is metadata, never live authentication, qualification or funding.

A selected-project grant's settings. The owner may enlarge; a project admin may only narrow (eligibility, caps, concurrency, expiry). Only Markdown research on research-sol-medium-v1 is contributable; Stop/finish settlement and benefit-only funding are refused as unsupported.

The caller's own API account record: one accounting root per owner and provider unless separate ownership is recorded. Provenance is the owner's declaration, never provider-verified. No key, billing id or token.

Metadata for a connection on the caller's own account: its label and the operator custodian's label. It is created as draft; no key is sent, stored or accepted here. Custody is registered by the operator, outside this API.
Grant one selected project, of which the owner is a current member. Private by default: no grant, no use.

The owner pauses, resumes or revokes (final). block_new_calls: no new dispatch or paid model call once authority fails; an already-authorized output may publish under its original payer, unless revoked or admin-disabled; an active provider request is not stopped.
The caller's own explicit choice of a contribution for research in this project, at the grant revision seen. Never falls back to another payer; null when cleared.

credentialRef.description: The reference NAME the operator host reads the key from; never a key value.

value.description: The caller's own API accounts, connections and grants. Owner only: nobody else's, and no key value, fingerprint, billing id or provider balance (always unknown).

eligibleForMe.description: Permission only. Whether it can fund work now is readiness.

value.description: What a project member may see of a contribution shared with the project: limits, state and their own readiness. No account, usage, credential reference, slots or other projects.

Who pays which meter for a research task: model calls by the contributor's API account under its frozen grant and credential revision, search and read by the project. Requested, accepted and observed settings stay distinct; accepted is unknown.
